_doc: Shared escort encounters: exploration shopping/sightseeing/meal/partyGames/nearMiss; nightVisit is featureNightEventIDs off-time content (ActiveHours complement). Night visit requires retained hidden cast at result eligibility, restores that cast once, chooses one singleton and keeps it in the party. Wake route explicitly DisruptSleep; sleep route does not. Action branches gate actual success, failure and success share one cleanup. Existing narrative/localization preserved.

list._comment: Shared daily result dispatch. Result-scoped teamRequirement keeps party singleton. Eligibility requires retained hidden cast; restore that roster once, then select one retained client. Preparation and cleanup are scene-local; never recover the captive or release the cast.

Move the retained singleton client to the party before reversed APs. Comparisons dispatch separately from effects. Check access before removing unlocked clothing; only preparation paths request Redress. APs retain their own anatomy/readiness/access validation and flush actual gains once through common cleanup. nyotai randomly selects the explicitly specified oral_B/oral_V, client -> party; no new narrative or forced daily climax.

events.label: photo_quality
events._comment: The four in-frame outcomes have equal weight and identical eligibility: touch/upload are independent 50% axes. Satisfaction is a separate 3:2 roll for every combination.

list._comment: Auto (silent) event of exp_event_erav_escort_nearMiss. Self = player, Targets[party] = the captive. Lines go into the exploration log entry. Branch options hold comparisons + jump only; the last option of each branch is the fallback.

Determine party wake/sleep mode before any client preparation. The wake route disrupts party sleep once with discarded wake output; the sleep route never wakes the party. Restore hidden clients separately, then select a singleton. The captive is not recovered. nextEventID preserves the selected mode and party context.

Entered after party wake/sleep mode is fixed and hidden-client readiness restored. Select one retained hidden client; no fresh loan/release. Trust nv_mode without a second sleeping check or wake call. Gates contain comparisons + jump only. AP failures go to neutral error and common cleanup.

events.label: mode_pick
events._comment: Use the mode selected before client preparation; do not re-check or wake the party here.

zh-cn.exp_event_erav_escort_nightVisit_result: 客人深夜来到了$names$的房间
zh-cn.event_erav_escort_nightVisit_wake_fore:
客人把$party.name$从被窝里摇醒，手指随即探进内裤按上私处，拨开缝隙抠了进去。
半梦半醒的身体被搅出黏腻的水声。她攥紧被角压住嗓子，没敢出声。
zh-cn.event_erav_escort_nightVisit_wake_front:
手指抽出去的瞬间，肉棒跟着抵进湿开的私处，整根没入到最深处。
客人掐着她的腰开始抽送，每记都顶到深处。被窝里的撞击声越来越响，她连攥床单的力气都散了。
最后客人把腰抵死在她腿间，精液尽数灌了进去。
zh-cn.event_erav_escort_nightVisit_wake_back:
客人把她的腰抬高，龟头抵住肛门缓缓撑了进去。
后穴被整根贯穿时她闷哼出声，床单被攥出深深的褶皱。
客人伏在她背上加速顶弄，最后整根没入，把精液泄进了肠壁深处。
zh-cn.event_erav_escort_nightVisit_wake_after_:
客人把软下来的肉棒塞回她嘴里，命令她含着舔干净。
她用舌尖把残留的精液和爱液逐处舐净，客人的呼吸很快就沉了下去。

客人趴回枕头上，抓着她的后颈把她的脸按进自己股间，命令她舔肛门。
她的舌尖刚抵上褶皱处，头顶便响起了鼾声。她被按着继续舔，直到攥着她的手松开。
zh-cn.event_erav_escort_nightVisit_wake_end: 客人睡熟后手还搭在她的胸口。精液顺着股缝在床单上洇开，$party.name$睁着眼睛，数着窗帘缝里的天色慢慢变亮。
zh-cn.event_erav_escort_nightVisit_sleep_start: 客人放轻动作掀开被角，把她的内裤褪到脚踝。私处暴露在冷气里，$party.name$只是皱了皱眉，翻出半声呓语。
zh-cn.event_erav_escort_nightVisit_sleep_fore:
客人的手指拨开阴唇探了进去，在甬道里缓慢地抠弄。
睡梦里的身体诚实地泛起湿意，爱液顺着指缝溢出来。她曲起腰，喉间漏出细碎的哼。
zh-cn.event_erav_escort_nightVisit_sleep_front:
肉棒抵开濡湿的私处，缓缓整根没入。她在睡梦中绷紧脚背，没有被弄醒。
客人压低身子缓慢抽送，睡熟的内壁把肉棒咬得很紧。最后他把精液泄在她子宫口，抽身时带出的白浊淌在了床单上。
zh-cn.event_erav_escort_nightVisit_sleep_back:
客人把她的身子侧拢进怀里，龟头抵住肛门，借着残余的爱液缓缓挤了进去。
她的眉心拧紧，呼吸始终匀长。客人在紧热的肠壁里顶弄到泄精，整根埋着抖了几下才退出来。
zh-cn.event_erav_escort_nightVisit_sleep_end:
客人替她掖回被角，轻手轻脚地离开了房间。
$party.name$睡到了早上。白浊干涸在股缝里，被褥上的痕迹要照进阳光才看得见。
